name: MAGNETIC STIRRER WITH HOT PLATE
desc: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Magnetic Stirrer with Hot Plate combines continuous heating and stirring functions into a single robust unit. Ideal for culture media preparation and chemical applications, it features a stainless steel 304 hot plate, thermostatic or digital PID controller, and a precise speed regulator.
principle: The INNOLAB INSTRUMENTS Magnetic Stirrer with Hot Plate operates on the principle of electromagnetic induction and resistive heating to provide simultaneous mixing and thermal control for laboratory applications. A rotating magnetic field, generated by a motor-driven magnet beneath the stainless steel 304 top plate, couples with a PTFE-coated magnetic stir bar immersed in the sample, inducing vortex flow for homogeneous mixing of liquids, dissolution of solids, and suspension of particulates. The integrated hot plate employs resistive heating elements regulated by a PID controller, which continuously modulates power output based on feedback from a thermocouple or PT100 sensor to maintain precise setpoint temperatures up to 200°C with minimal overshoot. This dual-function design is essential for preparing culture media such as nutrient agar, LB broth, and potato dextrose agar in microbiology labs, where uniform heat distribution prevents localized scorching and ensures complete dissolution of agar and dextrose. B.Sc and M.Sc students use the unit for organic synthesis reactions, recrystallization of compounds like acetanilide, and titration experiments requiring controlled heating and stirring. PhD researchers and chemists rely on it for reflux setups, polymer dissolution, nanoparticle synthesis, and handling of corrosive reagents such as concentrated sulfuric acid, hydrochloric acid, and organic solvents like DMSO, DMF, and toluene, provided appropriate fume hood and secondary containment are used. The instrument supports compliance with ISO 8655 for liquid handling precision and ASTM E691 for interlaboratory repeatability when used in standardized assay preparations.
sop: Place the magnetic stirrer with hot plate on a level, stable, heat-resistant surface away from flammable vapors and ensure the power cord is undamaged.
Connect the unit to a grounded 220V 50Hz power supply and switch ON the main power switch.
Place a suitable borosilicate glass beaker or flask containing the sample and a clean, appropriately sized PTFE-coated magnetic stir bar onto the center of the stainless steel 304 top plate.
Turn the stirring speed regulator knob slowly clockwise to initiate stirring; adjust gradually to the desired RPM, ensuring the stir bar rotates smoothly without decoupling or splashing.
To set the heating temperature, press the 'SET' button once on the PID controller; the display will flash the current setpoint value.
Use the 'UP' and 'DOWN' arrows to adjust to the required target temperature (e.g., 80°C for agar dissolution or 150°C for solvent evaporation).
Press 'SET' again to lock the value; the controller will now drive the hot plate toward the setpoint and maintain it automatically.
Monitor the process periodically; never leave the instrument unattended while heating volatile, flammable, or corrosive chemicals.
After completion, switch OFF the heating function first, reduce stirring speed to zero, and allow the hot plate to cool below 50°C before removing the vessel.
Switch OFF the main power, unplug the unit, and clean the top plate with a soft damp cloth and mild detergent; do not immerse the unit in water or allow liquid ingress into the controller housing.

SAFETY WARNING: Always wear heat-resistant gloves and safety goggles when handling hot vessels; never touch the top plate immediately after use as it can remain above 100°C and cause severe burns. Do not use the hot plate with sealed containers or highly volatile solvents without a fume hood, as vapor accumulation may cause explosion or fire.
features: Combination of magnetic stirrer and hot plate in a single unit
Precise thermostatic or digital temperature controller
Adjustable speed regulator for continuous stirring
Available in 1, 2, and 5 Liters stirring capacities
